COMPETING DEFINITIONS OF HUMAN NATURE
THE IDEALIST / RELIGIOUS VIEW
Views man as a purely spiritual being. Used by ruling classes to preach
fatalism and submission to a predestined lot.
THE BIOLOGICAL / BOURGEOIS VIEW
Views man as a biological being governed by instinct. Used to justify
capitalist "law of the jungle" and treat man as a commodity to be bought/sold.
THE MARXIST VIEW
Views man as the "ensemble of social relations." Groundbreaking, but
incomplete.
THE JUCHE VIEW
Views man as a social being defined by Independence, Creativity, and
Consciousness.
